explanation: God-given peace and harmony that surpasses human understanding, a gift from God that guards the heart against worry.
A state of unease or anxiety about future events that Paul encourages believers to give over in prayer with thanksgiving.
An expression of recognition and gratitude toward God, an attitude that should accompany all prayers to counteract worry.
Belonging to heaven or the kingdom of God; describes things of highest value in contrast to earthly goods.
God-given righteous conduct and morality that is part of the good life believers are called to practice.
